audience: operations and accounts payable teams that process business documents in Rossum queues

useCases.title: See which documents wait for review
useCases.text: List the queues, then list the annotations in one queue with the status to_review. Each annotation is one processed document.

useCases.title: Read the extracted fields of a document
useCases.text: Open one annotation to see its status, queue and assignee. Then read each extracted field with its value and confidence.

useCases.title: Find why a document skipped automation
useCases.text: Open the annotation to see its queue and status. Then list the automation blockers for it, such as a missing field or a validation rule.

useCases.title: Search annotations with a query
useCases.text: Search annotations with a query such as status to_review. Search results can lag a few seconds behind changes.

useCases.title: Start and confirm a reviewed annotation
useCases.text: Start validation to assign an annotation to you. After review, confirm its data. Confirmed annotations can trigger the queue's hooks and workflows.
